subject: change how the confidence intervals of geom_smooth are calculated

messages.author: 01703070bc90636a
messages.subject: change how the confidence intervals of geom_smooth are calculated
parts:
Good day,

I wold like to change the way limits for the blur bar plotted by geom_smooth are calculated; I actually need to define my own error function.

Is it doable?Or is there a way to emulate it?

regards,

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: change how the confidence intervals of geom_smooth are calculated
parts:
If you want to do something more complicated than geom_smooth() will
easily allow, the best solution is probably to compute your own point
estimates/predictions and confidence intervals outside of ggplot and
then use

... + geom_line(data=predframe) +
geom_ribbon(data=predframe,aes(ymin=lwr_bound,ymax=upr_bound),
colour=NA,alpha=0.2)

or some such to add the prediction and CIs to the plot.
